title: Charm loop particle Part_Charm_Loop_01 borrowed as an owned copy (framework-activated since Core a66a6379)
summary: Borrow the resident Part_Charm_Loop_01 body as a plugin-owned copy through ctx.Effects.Borrow. With the deployed framework fix (2026-09-07, Core a66a6379) the clone comes back active with all seven particle systems playing; on 2026-09-06 the same borrow returned an inactive clone (root activeSelf=False, zero particles) that the probe had to activate by hand. This is an isolated particle duplication at the world origin until positioned, not the Charm spell and not a beam. The body only becomes borrowable after the target sequence has played (warmed process); nothing here demonstrates loading from an unloaded state.

context.residency: the body must already be loaded: Assets.Find listed zero Charm objects before the target sequence played and two clone roots after (E1)
context.activation: With the deployed Core (a66a6379, 2026-09-07) the framework activates the owned clone itself (clone.SetActive(true) before Play in UnityEffectRuntime.BorrowParticle): Borrow returned an active clone with all seven systems playing. Historical: on 2026-09-06 the fix was not deployed and the probe activated its own clone by hand (E2, E3).
context.position: the framework places the clone at the world origin; the caller positions it (the 2026-09-06 probe placed it at (-1719.7, 11.3, -1455.2)).

initialization: Play the target sequence (or otherwise have the body resident); confirm with Assets.Find.

ctx.Effects.Borrow(AssetKind.Particle, "Part_Charm_Loop_01") -> tracked owned clone under the plugin's effects root, active and playing (B1). The static Assets.Borrow without owner/pluginId files the clone under EffectOwnership.UnownedId, and with owner null it is not swept at plugin unload even when a pluginId is given (B2).
Position the clone; then read back activeHierarchy/playing/particle counts if the result matters (B1: 7/7).
cleanup: Dispose the effect handle: 'Effects: disposed Particle Part_Charm_Loop_01(Clone)' (E4).

Dispose also runs on plugin unload through the ownership root when the handle came from ctx.Effects.Borrow (tracked). The static Assets.Borrow without owner/pluginId is not swept with the plugin (source-checked, Assets.cs InferPluginId).

explicitCleanup.note: Scopes: (a) direct Charm Dispose: the clone was detached from the root in the same frame (B1); complete Unity destruction after deferred cleanup was not read back (this run did not re-exercise Dispose). (b) Tracked plugin unload of Flame/Embers: observed (B3); this run did not re-exercise those bodies. (c) Tracked Charm borrow unloaded while active: observed-success on both Removal and Swap. Removal: B5 (live-rig 20260907T093055Z-charm-tracked-unload). `.catalogex warm` played sequence -541113174 at the player (carrier 567415:12); `.catalogex borrow` on the client through the Sample context; CHARMROOT children=1 while active; client-side Removal of Sample; Effects disposed Particle 'Part_Charm_Loop_01' 6 ms after Progenitor.Sample.dll removed; CHARMROOT children=0 afterwards; client stayed connected; run complete; logSignals fatal 0. The client replica of the warm carrier (99414:354) outlived server disposal and was destroyed by the rig at cleanup. Swap: B6 (live-rig 20260908T045301Z-swap-client). Three client Sample swaps with a tracked borrow active; disposed at unload (reason=Swap); new-generation borrow/dispose usable; one `FROSTSTYLE client enabled=` line per toggle; connection retained. Client NetworkedSequence leftovers were destroyed at cleanup as manual recovery, not automatic cleanup. (d) Null-owner static borrow: not swept at unload (B2). The 2026-09-06 disposal log line (E4) proves the call, not removal. sides client: B5 Removal and B6 Swap are client Sample unloads of the owned particle.

poolReuse.note: The game's pooled source objects were not compared before/after; Assets.Find still listed the original Part_Charm_Loop_01(Clone) after the owned copies were gone, which says nothing about their state. sides client: pooling would be a client observation if tested.
